description: Add one or more items to the user’s tidee workspace from ordinary language. Give it the whole thought as the user said it — "book the MOT and call Sam about Friday" — and tidee works out the separate items, which box each belongs in, and any dates. It REWORDS as it files: "get some milk tomorrow" becomes an item called "milk" with a date. That is wanted when the user is thinking aloud, and wrong when they have chosen their words — if they quoted a title, use create_item instead. Nothing is ever lost: if the text cannot be interpreted it is stored verbatim as a single item.

parentId.description: Box id to put everything in. Omit to let tidee choose, which is usually right. Ids come from list_boxes.

text.description: What the user wants to remember, in their own words.
